items.name: Pu-erh Raw Tea — Snow-Whisking (2019)
items.nameZh: 普洱生茶（2019年拂雪）
items.description: Orchid fragrance is rich and pronounced. The liquor is gentle and sweet, with a silky mouthfeel and a lingering, persistent finish.
items.descriptionZh: 幽兰花香浓郁，香高馥郁。茶汤柔和甜润，水路细腻，回甘持久。

items.name: Pu-erh Raw Tea — Biandao (2021)
items.nameZh: 普洱生茶（2021年冰岛）
items.description: Delicately sweet with a long, enduring energy. Bright golden liquor, smooth and full-bodied, leaving a prolonged, cooling sweetness across the palate.
items.descriptionZh: 香甜细腻，气韵悠长，清凉愉悦。汤色金黄透亮，口感细腻醇厚，口腔两颊生津绵延持久。

items.name: Pu-erh Ripe Tea — 7581 White Paper Version (1998)
items.nameZh: 普洱熟茶（1998年白纸版7581）
items.description: A classic 7581 profile. Pronounced aged aroma with subtle medicinal notes. The liquor is rich and mellow, layered in fragrance, with a complex, evolving finish.
items.descriptionZh: 典型的7581经典滋味。陈香显著、略显药香、茶汤醇厚，香气丰富，滋味变化层次明显。

items.name: Pu-erh Ripe Tea — Hehua Ancient Trees (2018)
items.nameZh: 普洱熟茶（2018年荷华古树）
items.description: A ruby-bright liquor with a clean, pronounced aged aroma. Velvety and smooth on entry, the texture is almost glutinous—like biting into a rice dumpling steeped in pu-erh. Gentle and warming in nature.
items.descriptionZh: 汤色如红酒般瑰丽透亮，陈香显著，干净无杂异味，入口醇厚顺滑，汤感顺滑柔软，如嚼着普洱味的糯米粽子，整体茶性柔和温润。

items.name: Yunnan Black Tea — Wintersweet (2021)
items.nameZh: 云南红茶（2021年梅占）
items.description: Honeyed notes lift high above the cup. Golden, luminous liquor with a rich, mellow sweetness and a soft, rounded body.
items.descriptionZh: 蜜香高扬，茶汤金黄透亮，甜香浓郁，茶汤柔和甜润。

items.name: Wuyi Black Tea — Lapsang Souchong
items.nameZh: 武夷红茶（正山小种）
items.description: Its signature is pine-smoke and longan fruit. Amber liquor, brisk and enduring in aroma, with a rich, lively sweetness. The leaves unfurl to a bright copper hue, soft and substantial.
items.descriptionZh: 松烟香、桂圆味是它的显赫标志。茶汤呈琥珀色，香气高爽持久，滋味浓纯，活泼甘甜，叶底明亮，呈古铜色，叶张柔软厚实。

items.name: Wuyi Rock Tea — Cassia Tea
items.nameZh: 武夷岩茶（武夷肉桂）
items.description: Cream, stone fruit, and cassia bark on the nose. Full-bodied with a sweet, lingering aftertaste that clings to the cheeks. Bright orange liquor; the leaves show a pale green center edged in red. The signature "rock rhyme" of cassia endures through six or seven infusions.
items.descriptionZh: 茶汤特具奶油、花果、桂皮般的香气；入口醇厚回甘，咽后齿颊留香，茶汤橙黄清澈，叶底匀亮，呈淡绿底红镶边，冲泡六七次仍有"岩韵"的肉桂香。

items.name: Wuyi Rock Tea — Narcissus
items.nameZh: 武夷岩茶（慧苑坑水仙）
items.description: Crystalline orange-yellow liquor, soft and weighty on the tongue. Deep yet quietly elegant fragrance—orchid and aged wood, with the distinct "bush character" of old groves. Silky and expansive on entry, with a resonant throat feel and a pronounced, lasting body.
items.descriptionZh: 汤色清艳透亮，显橙黄色，水柔，香浓而清幽，有独特的兰花香和木质味，丛味，入口顺滑绵柔，喉韵足，滋味重。
